summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K on 18 August 2026 announcing the publication of its 2026 Annual Report and Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026, following preliminary results released on 6 August 2026. The filing also notes that the Notice of Annual General Meeting and Form of Proxy will be made available to shareholders on 30 September 2026. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of annual financial results and corporate governance documents, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, transactions, or extraordinary events described. The filing simply satisfies ongoing reporting obligations for a foreign private issuer.
